\usepackage[paperwidth=420pt,paperheight=560pt,textwidth=310pt,textheight=210pt,top=42pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}

\makeatletter
\newcount\audit@tries
\let\audit@drawpiece\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{%
  \global\advance\audit@tries by1
  \ifnum\audit@tries>1000 \errmessage{AUDIT retry limit}\fi
  \typeout{AUDIT TRIAL type=#1; split=\the\ht\dte@splitresult+\the\dp\dte@splitresult; remainder=\ifvoid\dte@extbox VOID\else NONVOID\fi,\the\ht\dte@extbox+\the\dp\dte@extbox; avail=\the\dte@availht; capacity=\the\dte@fitroom; min=\dte@minht}%
  \begingroup
  \edef\audit@next{\endgroup\noexpand\audit@drawpiece{#1}\noexpand\write16{AUDIT SHIP type=#1; split=\the\ht\dte@splitresult+\the\dp\dte@splitresult; avail=\the\dte@availht; capacity=\the\dte@fitroom}}%
  \audit@next
}
\let\audit@measureheight\dte@measureheight
\def\dte@measureheight#1{\audit@measureheight#1\typeout{AUDIT MEASURE type=\dte@piecetype; physical=\the\ht\dte@tbox+\the\dp\dte@tbox; charged=\the\dte@fitht; capacity=\the\dte@fitroom}}
\makeatother
